Registry version: **1** · Updated: **2026-10-06**

The JSON registry is canonical. Current public copy may use only an active
claim's exact `approved_wording`; controls, withdrawals, and withheld records
are retained here for auditability and excluded from promotional blocks.

## Approved current wording

- **LoCoMo accuracy:** Caura scored 77.9% (1,199/1,540) under its documented LoCoMo semantic-judge protocol using the retrieval-augmented agentic-v1 pipeline.
- **LongMemEval reference judge:** Caura answered 461 of 500 LongMemEval_S questions correctly (92.2%) under the benchmark's GPT-4o reference judge.
- **LongMemEval secondary judge:** The same 500 frozen LongMemEval_S answers scored 90.2% (451/500) under the secondary Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite judge.
- **LongMemEval token efficiency:** On LongMemEval_S, the median compact retrieved context was 22,410 tokens versus a 107,706-token full haystack: 79.2% context-only savings; counting every reader call yields 75.4%.

Only active, approved claims appear here. Control, withdrawn, and withheld
records remain in the evidence registry and are excluded from promotional copy.
See [`evidence/claims.json`](evidence/claims.json) and
[`EVIDENCE.md`](EVIDENCE.md). Do not hand-edit this block.

## All claims

### Caura retrieval-augmented LoCoMo accuracy

- **ID:** `locomo_caura_retrieval_accuracy_2026_09`
- **Status / role:** ACTIVE / headline
- **Measurement / verified:** 2026-09-22 / 2026-10-05
- **Approved wording:** Caura scored 77.9% (1,199/1,540) under its documented LoCoMo semantic-judge protocol using the retrieval-augmented agentic-v1 pipeline.
- **Scope:** All 1,540 scored LoCoMo questions in categories 1-4.
- **Evaluation:** LoCoMo category 1-4 questions; sample=1540; numerator=1199; denominator=1540; All scored category 1-4 questions; adversarial category 5 is reported separately and excluded from this headline.
- **Answering model:** Google Gemini / gemini-3.8-flash; snapshot=not recorded/not applicable. The public run records this model name but no provider-issued immutable snapshot identifier.
- **Judge:** Google Gemini / gemini-3.8-flash; snapshot=not recorded/not applicable. Three seeded votes per frozen answer; the public run records no provider-issued immutable snapshot identifier.
- **Configuration:** agentic-v1 retrieval and answer pipeline on the settled caura-balanced-50-v3-20260910 store Parameters: `{"chunk_characters": 4000, "judge_votes": 3, "thinking_tokens": 2048, "top_k": 30}`
- **Code:** https://github.com/caura-ai/yanki-locomo @ `254737614b228ecc4a272e4f17dbb9197c5fb146`.
- **Measurements:** 77.9% LLM-judge semantic accuracy
- **Methodology:** https://github.com/caura-ai/yanki-locomo/blob/254737614b228ecc4a272e4f17dbb9197c5fb146/README.md
- **Raw result:** unavailable
- **Reproducible harness:** https://github.com/caura-ai/yanki-locomo/tree/254737614b228ecc4a272e4f17dbb9197c5fb146
- **Evidence gap:** None recorded.
- **Caveats:** This is the Caura retrieval-augmented result, not the full-context control. The semantic-judge protocol is not the original LoCoMo token-F1 metric. The answering model and semantic judge are both recorded as gemini-3.8-flash; this is not an independent-model judge result. The repository documents the summary but does not currently commit the full question-level result artifact.

### LoCoMo full-context reader baseline

- **ID:** `locomo_full_context_control_2026_09`

- **Answering model:** OpenAI / gpt-5-mini; snapshot=not recorded/not applicable. The committed result records gpt-5-mini and temperature 1 but no provider-issued immutable snapshot identifier.

- **Measurements:** 87.27% LLM-judge semantic accuracy

- **Evidence gap:** Benchmark-owner confirmation and H1 approval of the final public wording are pending.
- **Caveats:** This is a full-context reader baseline, not a Caura memory-system score. The harness records no Caura retrieval in this arm. The public artifact was committed on 2026-09-28; the benchmark owner must confirm the exact execution date before activation.
- **Withheld 2026-10-06:** Awaiting benchmark-owner confirmation and H1 approval of final public wording.

### LongMemEval accuracy under the reference judge

- **ID:** `longmemeval_reference_accuracy_2026_09_15`
- **Status / role:** ACTIVE / headline
- **Measurement / verified:** 2026-09-15 / 2026-10-05
- **Approved wording:** Caura answered 461 of 500 LongMemEval_S questions correctly (92.2%) under the benchmark's GPT-4o reference judge.
- **Scope:** All 500 LongMemEval_S questions with one configuration across all six question types.
- **Evaluation:** LongMemEval_S; sample=500; numerator=461; denominator=500; All 500 questions; no category filter or held-out subset.

- **Code:** https://github.com/caura-ai/caura-longmemeval @ `3b1e293aacc652694822ab4062c15fef73536335`.
- **Measurements:** 92.2% Reference-judge accuracy

### LongMemEval compact-context token savings

- **ID:** `longmemeval_token_savings_2026_09_15`
- **Status / role:** ACTIVE / headline
- **Measurement / verified:** 2026-09-15 / 2026-10-05
- **Approved wording:** On LongMemEval_S, the median compact retrieved context was 22,410 tokens versus a 107,706-token full haystack: 79.2% context-only savings; counting every reader call yields 75.4%.
- **Scope:** Median token counts across all 500 headline questions, using the answering model's tokenizer.
- **Evaluation:** LongMemEval_S headline run; sample=500; numerator=None; denominator=None; Medians over every question; token savings is derived from token counts, not correct-answer counts.
- **Answering model:** Google Gemini / gemini-3.8-flash; snapshot=not recorded/not applicable. Its tokenizer produced the recorded counts; provider snapshot not recorded.
- **Judge:** not applicable / not applicable; snapshot=not recorded/not applicable. Judging does not participate in token counting.
- **Configuration:** Compact context layout from the caura-500-opaque saved retrieval pass. Parameters: `{"context_format": "compact", "questions": 500, "tokenizer": "Gemini reader tokenizer"}`
- **Code:** https://github.com/caura-ai/caura-longmemeval @ `3b1e293aacc652694822ab4062c15fef73536335`.
- **Measurements:** 79.2% Context token savings; 75.4% All-reader-call token savings; 22,410 tokens Median retrieved context; 26,482 tokens Median all-reader-call total; 107,706 tokens Median full haystack
- **Methodology:** https://github.com/caura-ai/caura-longmemeval/blob/3b1e293aacc652694822ab4062c15fef73536335/REPRODUCE.md
- **Raw result:** https://github.com/caura-ai/caura-longmemeval/blob/3b1e293aacc652694822ab4062c15fef73536335/outputs/caura-500-opaque-compact/context_tokens.json
- **Reproducible harness:** https://github.com/caura-ai/caura-longmemeval/tree/3b1e293aacc652694822ab4062c15fef73536335
- **Evidence gap:** None recorded.
- **Caveats:** 79.2% is context-only; the all-reader-call comparison is 75.4%.

## Updating a claim

1. Update `evidence/claims.json`; never erase withdrawal or withholding history.
2. Run `python3 scripts/evidence_registry.py --write`.
3. Run `python3 scripts/evidence_registry.py --check` and the focused tests.
4. Review the generated diff and the public-surface denylist result.
